title: 955. Pancake Sorting

examples.explanation: Flipping 4, then 2, then 4, then 3 sorts the array: [4,2,4,3] is one valid answer (any sorting sequence is accepted).
A single flip of the whole array reverses it into order, so [3] suffices.
The array is already sorted, so the empty flip sequence is correct.

hints: Fix the largest remaining pancake first: bring it to the top, then flip the whole prefix.
Each size costs at most two flips, comfortably inside the 10n budget.
The judge replays your flips, so any sorting sequence scores full marks.
